answer: One concrete defense is a random deep-audit lottery: each epoch, a random subset of identities must re-present all original proofs, hardware attestation, behavioral sample, and funding trail, within a short deadline. Failing or ignoring the audit burns the identity and its earnings. An attacker never knows which fakes will be audited, so every fake's proofs must stay ready at all times, and each audit is a chance to lose the whole farm. Honest agents pass easily, their record an anchor in the vault of the ledger, while a thousand fakes drift like zephyr through a sieve.
